dashboard.not_tracked_hint: Not tracked yet — this is a fallback for a project set up outside the wizard; normally onboarding tracks all three together.
onboarding.subtitle: First-run setup — this only happens once per project.
onboarding.directory.heading: 1. Project directory
onboarding.directory.description: Choose where this project's files (and its git history) will live.
onboarding.confirm_existing.heading: Existing project found
onboarding.confirm_existing.description: This directory already has an elt project in it.
onboarding.repository.heading: 2. Repository
onboarding.repository.username_label: Username (optional — most hosts accept anything when Token is set)
onboarding.repository.push_manual: Manual — push when I choose to
onboarding.repository.token_hint: The token needs read and write access to the repository. If this URL already has a project on it, joining it will skip the upload/language steps below — it already has its own.
onboarding.upload.heading: 3. Upload your files ({idx} of {total})
onboarding.upload.description: Upload {name} to seed its keys and discover which languages it already has columns for — or skip it if the file is missing/not needed. You can upload it later via the "Sync" button.
onboarding.languages.heading: 4. Languages
onboarding.languages.description: Pick every language you're translating into — Localization, Dialogues and PDA are always tracked together for the same languages. You can change this later.
upload_slot.filename_hint: Only a file named exactly "{name}" is accepted.
upload_slot.filename_error: Expected a file named {expected}, but selected file is named {actual}.
upload_slot.skip: Skip — I don't have this file
upload_slot.conflict_heading: This file has problems that need confirmation
upload_slot.conflict_description: Upload was refused because data would be lost while parsing this file. Review the issues below, then force it if this is expected.
sync.title: Sync {fileType}
sync.chain_source_cleared: This sync changed content, so the previously uploaded chain source (Dialogues.ecf/PDA.yaml) was reset — chain browsing needs a fresh upload before it works again.
workspace.search_placeholder: Search key, English, or translation text…
admin.title: Owner
admin.copy_hint: Copy this now and send it to them securely — it can't be shown again.
admin.email_label: Email (optional — used for their git commits)
admin.is_admin_label: Maintainer — can manage users and repository settings
admin.no_users: No users configured yet — this server is open to anyone who can reach it.
admin.loopback_only_hint: Adding users is disabled while the server runs on 127.0.0.1. To enable it: run elt serve --listen 0.0.0.0:<port> (or similar) instead.
admin.error_first_user_must_be_maintaine: This project has no Maintainer yet — the first user added must be one.
admin.regen_hint: Their old token stops working immediately — copy this now and send it to them securely.
token_prompt.heading: Sign in
token_prompt.description: This project requires an access token. Ask whoever administers this server for one.
token_prompt.label: Access token
directory_picker.heading: Choose a folder
directory_picker.truncated_hint: Showing the first matches only — keep typing above to narrow it down.
batches.title: Batches — {fileType}
batches.split_invalid_count: Enter a positive number of batches.
batches.split_blocked_hint: There's already an open batch for {lang} — reclaim it first.
chains.needs_source: No chain source uploaded yet — pick the file below.
chains.tree_capped: This chain is very large — the tree was cut off at a size limit and may be missing some branches.
history.title: History
history.export_hint: Export the whole project (current files and history). Sensitive data (user accounts, tokens) is never included.
history.compact_hint: Permanently discards every commit before this one — later commits are replayed unchanged, content is never altered. Admin-only on a shared server.
lang_switcher.label: Translation language
glossary.title: glossary
glossary.fill_all_hint: Search all keys for every term in this list and record which keys mention them (a longer term wins over a shorter one it contains).
glossary.clear_confirm_body: This deletes all {n} term(s) in the {lang} glossary, including drafts and rejected terms. This can't be undone from here — only by rolling back to an earlier commit in History.
glossary.prune_notice: {n} key(s) no longer exist and were removed from this term's list.
glossary.show_in_keys_hint: Show these keys in the Keys workspace.
glossary.ai_translate_matches_hint: Update these keys' translation via AI.
glossary.import_schema_hint: A term that already exists (by name) is updated in place; a status you leave out is preserved on an existing term and defaults to draft on a new one.
glossary.filter_hint_default: Draft and approved terms — the usual view, hiding rejected ones.
glossary.filter_hint_draft: Proposed terms not yet reviewed — not used in translation, the AI doesn't see them yet.
glossary.filter_hint_approved: Reviewed terms — only these are included in the AI's translation prompt.
glossary.filter_hint_rejected: Blacklisted terms — never used, and never suggested again by automatic term discovery.
glossary.filter_hint_all: Terms of any status, including rejected.
glossary.row_locked_by: Locked by {owner} for editing — you can still view it.
sync_review.heading: Review changed keys
sync_review.empty: Nothing to review — this file type had no prior state to compare against.
sync_review.cleared_all: Cleared every translation in this list.
aijobs.title: AI jobs — {fileType}
aijobs.start_mine_hint: Translates every key from your own open batch(es) — force is implied, since these are the exact keys checked out for you to work on.
aijobs.start_discover_terms_warning: The key's text is sent to the AI twice — once to translate, once to look for terms. With a paid API, this roughly doubles the cost for keys where this is on.
aijobs.start_priority_label: Priority (jump ahead of any other job's queued calls)
aijobs.priority_hint: Priority job — its AI calls jump ahead of ordinary jobs' queued calls
aijobs.empty: No jobs run yet this session.
aijobs.watch_hint: This is the job shown in the activity bar's progress widget.
workspace2.filter_hint_untranslated: No translation has been entered yet.
workspace2.filter_hint_stale: The English text changed after this was translated — worth rechecking.
workspace2.filter_hint_needs_review: Automatic validation found a problem (e.g. mismatched tags or placeholders).
workspace2.filter_hint_needs_work: Untranslated, stale, or flagged by validation — anything not yet in good shape.
workspace2.filter_hint_needs_confirmatio: An AI draft nobody has confirmed yet — otherwise clean, but still needs a human look.
workspace2.filter_hint_ok: Translated, not stale, no problems, and not an unconfirmed AI draft.
workspace2.pick_a_key: Select a key on the left to view and edit it.
workspace2.pick_a_chain: Select a chain on the left to view and edit its keys.
workspace2.pick_a_term: Select a term on the left, or add a new one.
workspace2.ai_translate_failed: Translation failed — check the AI-jobs list for details.
workspace2.batches_unassigned_hint: {n} open batch(es) with nobody assigned — assign or reclaim them.
sync_import.title: Sync {fileType}
workspace2.locked_by: Locked by {owner} — read-only until they finish.
workspace2.row_locked_by: Locked by {owner} — cannot be opened right now.
workspace2.owner_name_hint: Your name, shown to others when you're editing a key they try to open.
workspace2.lang_locked_to_batch: Locked to the language of your assigned batch.
workspace2.filter_hint_flagged: Marked as a draft version — either by hand, or automatically when you navigated away from an unsaved edit.
workspace2.needs_review_hint: Marks the key so you can come back to it later. Available only after the key has been saved. Set automatically when you navigate away from an unsaved edit.
settings.title: Settings
settings.server_address_hint: Host: 127.0.0.1 for this machine only, 0.0.0.0 for every network interface, or blank for every interface too. Port 0 picks a free port automatically.
settings.server_restart_required: After changing this, the server needs to be restarted.
settings.tls_cert_placeholder: leave empty to use a generated self-signed certificate
settings.tls_key_placeholder: leave empty to use a generated self-signed certificate
settings.tls_cert_hint: A self-signed certificate makes browsers show a trust warning on first connect — expected for local/internal use. For a real public deployment, point these two fields at a real certificate/key pair instead (e.g. from Let's Encrypt).
settings.ai_not_configured: Connect an AI provider to enable AI-assisted translation.
settings.ai_token_hint: Saving always overwrites the stored token with this field — don't leave it blank by accident.
settings.ai_models_empty: The provider returned no models — enter one manually.
settings.ai_param_mode_hint: Reasoning effort and temperature aren't usually combined — a reasoning model typically only honors one of them. Pick whichever your model actually supports.
settings.languages_hint: Every checked language is tracked across Localization, Dialogues, and PDA together. Unchecking one stops it from being tracked/exported — existing translations are kept and come back if you re-check it later.
import.title: Import {fileType}
import.heading: Import translations from a CSV
import.hint: Overwrites existing translations for the languages you select, from a file that already has them — unlike Update, which only ever reconciles English source text and never touches a translation. Matching is by key; keys this project doesn't have are simply skipped.
import.match_english_label: Also verify the English text matches
import.match_english_hint: Recommended: a key is only imported if the file's own English text for it matches what's currently in the project — protects against pasting in a translation authored for an older, since-changed version of that key.
import.nothing_applied: Nothing was applied — check the file and the selected languages.
import.skipped_unknown_key: {n} key(s) skipped — not present in this project.
import.skipped_english_mismatch: {n} key(s) skipped — English text didn't match.
import.confirm_warning: This will overwrite existing {fileType} translations for: {langs}. This cannot be undone automatically.
import.confirm_rollback_hint: If this turns out to be a mistake, you can roll back to a previous commit from History.
